# War Scroll Column 17 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**17:1** In the seventh lot, the great hand of God shall subdue [Belial and al]l the angels of his dominion and all the men of

**17:2** [his lot.] [...] The holy ones shall shine forth [...] to pursue [...] in utter

**17:3** destruction. And the priests shall blow the trumpets [...] and all the battle lines shall deploy

**17:4** against them [...] and the Sons of Light shall shine forth with the angelic host [...] in the truth of God, to strengthen

**17:5** [...] the Sons of Light. And they shall raise a great shout [...] and the dominion of [...]

**17:6** shall melt away, and the angels [...] shall strengthen [...] the covenant of God [...] in the midst of the battle [...]

**17:7** For this is the time appointed by God to bring low the prince of the dominion of wickedness. And He shall send

**17:8** eternal aid to the lot of His redemption through the power of the angel — He has magnified the authority of Michael

**17:9** in eternal light, to illumine with joy the covenant of Israel, peace and blessing for the lot of God, to exalt

**17:10** the authority of Michael among the divine beings and the dominion of Israel among all flesh.

**17:11** And righteousness shall rejoice on high, and all the sons of His truth shall be glad in eternal knowledge.

**17:12** And you, Sons of His covenant, be strong in the testing of God, until He lifts His hand

**17:13** and completes His trials — the mystery of His works. [...] And at the appointed time He shall bring low forever

**17:14** the Sons of Darkness; and there shall be no remnant and there shall be no survivor among the Sons of

**17:15** Darkness. [...] And the righteous shall shine forth [...] unto all the appointed times of

**17:16** eternity. [...] And the dominion of the Kittim shall come to an end, wickedness shall be vanquished without

**17:17** [rem]nant, and there shall be no survivor among all the Sons of Darkness [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows LOGOS throughout this pivotal column. Key decisions: "lot" (not "battle") for goral in 17:1 — the term carries theological weight as divine allotment. "Divine beings" for elim (17:10) per LOGOS, not EMET's "gods" or PNEUMA's "heavenly beings." "Sons of Light/Darkness" maintained per project convention, rejecting PNEUMA's "Children of Light." "Mystery" (singular) for raz in 17:13, not PNEUMA's "secret." Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
